plan.title: Buyer sends RFQ counter offer from QCS

steps.note: Open the multi-stage event creation flow.
Create an RFQ-only event so the QCS has a pricing round.
Add a line item for the vendor to quote.
Commit a bidding schedule before publishing.
Add one vendor whose bid will be countered.
Publish the RFQ so the vendor can submit a bid.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Submit a vendor bid so the QCS contains a live response.
Confirm the vendor bid was accepted.
Open the Quote Comparison Sheet containing the vendor bid.
Open the vendor's Counter Offer control, enter the new price, and send it.
Assert the QCS marks the vendor's bid as having a counter offer.
Check the expected pending counter-offer tag above the vendor.
Check that the buyer can revoke the pending counter offer.
Check for a successful send confirmation.
